testCase.name: [dev] S09 Line count edges: 12-line recording, 3-line recording, 3-paragraph typed note stored as one entry; full text, no truncation

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S09 「行数的边界：12 行的录音、3 行的录音、存成一条的 3 段打字记录；完整文字，不截断」 Line count edges: 12-line recording, 3-line recording, 3-paragraph typed note stored as one entry; full text, no truncation

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 4；TFA-92594 How it works 4）
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is.（TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given {hospitalPatient}: yesterday's bedside recording of 12 lines (alternating Dr/Pt), today's recording of 3 lines, and an archived 'Encounter notes' row holding a 3-paragraph typed note

When Open the Encounter tab; read the counts; open the '(prior)' row; open the '· Encounter notes' row

Then '(prior)' shows 12 lines and expands to all twelve, first to last. 'Most Recent' shows 3 lines. The notes row expands to the whole note

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. cp1: mustContain '12 lines', '3 lines', '(prior)', 'Most Recent'; mustNotContain L01, L12, QA16-H-NOTE (U3). '3 lines' can only be Most Recent's count: the other rows show '12 lines' and '1 lines', and neither contains it as a substring. A '1 line' or '2 lines' check would not discriminate ('1 lines' is the notes row, '2 lines' is inside '12 lines'). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U26；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
